name: tlon-retrain12_ct
purpose: THE GATE. Train ONE ct-s20624 (content-transient) and read the MODEL-side lag profile before buying the other eleven adapters. Corpus responsiveness is a property of the DATA; whether it reaches the MODEL is the open question the factorial and the chatbot are both downstream of.
read_with: tools/act2_model_lag.py — GO needs lag1 z >= 6.0 (Z_LAG1_MIN) and lag>=2 z <= 3.0 (Z_LAGN_MAX), thresholds imported from the corpus side and NOT to be touched
NOTE: ⛔ THIS IS THE SECOND ATTEMPT. The first ct-gate box trained ct-s20624, cleared F-LOCAL at render 0.969 / speak 1.000, completed all 14 solo probes, then died at the `manifest` stage on a hardcoded `expected 6 adapters` and was terminated by its own watchdog before the weights could be pulled. Both defects are fixed and red-proofed. ⭐ Its corpus is rebuilt with the post-2405a27 deterministic generator, so this one is sha-pinnable — the lost run's was not.
